exit 0
--- stdout
--- stderr
'wezterm' 'start' '--class' 'liza-adversarial' '--workspace' 'liza-adversarial' '--cwd' '<PROJECT>' '--' '/bin/sh' '-lc' 'set -e
wezterm_liza_send_prompt() {
pane_id="$1"
prompt="$2"
(
sleep 2
printf '"'"'%s'"'"' "$prompt" | wezterm cli --class '"'"'liza-adversarial'"'"' send-text --no-paste --pane-id "$pane_id"
printf '"'"'\r'"'"' | wezterm cli --class '"'"'liza-adversarial'"'"' send-text --no-paste --pane-id "$pane_id"
) &
}
pane_id_1=$(wezterm cli --class '"'"'liza-adversarial'"'"' split-pane --right --cwd '"'"'<PROJECT>'"'"' -- '"'"'codex'"'"')
wezterm_liza_send_prompt "$pane_id_1" '"'"'$adversarial-pairing reviewer-codex <PROJECT>/board.md'"'"'
pane_id_2=$(wezterm cli --class '"'"'liza-adversarial'"'"' split-pane --bottom --cwd '"'"'<PROJECT>'"'"' -- '"'"'codex'"'"')
wezterm_liza_send_prompt "$pane_id_2" '"'"'$adversarial-pairing reviewer-codex-2 <PROJECT>/board.md'"'"'
wezterm_liza_send_prompt "$WEZTERM_PANE" '"'"'$adversarial-pairing doer <PROJECT>/board.md'"'"'
exec '"'"'codex'"'"'
'
--- invocations
none
